text:
I left the demon locked

in a drawer,

in his little crepe bed.


outside the angel flies,

knocks at the door,

waits,


in one hand rhyme

like a tear,

in the other silence

like a sword.


throw me out of my body,

it is twelve o'clock,

without sun or stars.

translation.title: I Left the Demon Locked Up...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the drawer-bound demon and the angel carrying rhyme and silence.
